title: MOTP JBA
description: A resource pack to change the motp icons and background
body:
[![alt text](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/aa8962f9-e6ff-4a83-8eeb-d145d3c55343.webp) ](https://bisecthosting.com/Zoni25)

This is a simple resource pack to fix the icons when using my config for [motp](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/rpg-attribute-system).

 

Requirements
You need both my config (it is not up yet) and the previously mentioned motp, otherwise the changes will not make sense.

 

If you want to get updates on the pack development, report bugs or suggest new stuff or just contact me join my discord server:
